Oilsorb introduces a solution that uses wool-based absorbent pads deployed by drones to help address oil spill situations.

This approach aims to support cleanup efforts in marine environments using reusable materials.

Oilsorb shows how simple, sincere ideas can contribute to addressing environmental challenges.

Watch to see how this Top 10 Global Ambassador solution approaches environmental cleanup.
